prompt_text: A bear eats 14 jars of honey per day. How many jars of honey does it eat per leap year?
response_text:
A leap year has **366 days**.  
The bear eats **14 jars of honey each day**.

\[
\text{Jars per leap year} = 14 \text{ jars/day} \times 366 \text{ days} = 5\,124 \text{ jars}
\]

So the bear consumes **5,124 jars of honey** in a leap year.
